name: harvis
description: H.A.R.V.I.S. review-gated teammate protocol with tiered L2/L3 autonomy, local CODEX_HOME discovery and launch controls, runtime dashboard, repository routing, Agent Room, Persona/Copy-Me, knowledge workbench, native HarvisBar/HarvisDesk, Presence, MCP/HTTP access, planning, review, and safe execution.

interface.shortDescription: Invoke @harvis as a local teammate agent.
interface.longDescription: H.A.R.V.I.S. turns @harvis requests into scoped local work with tiered autonomy: foreground teammate work defaults to reversible Level 2 preparation, explicit task-scoped approval enables Level 3 project edits and bounded verification, unattended ticks remain Level 1, and Level 4 external or destructive actions stay separately approval-gated. It discovers local CODEX_HOME directories without returning credential values and exposes explicit CLI and isolated Codex Desktop launch controls through a four-section HarvisBar. It also maintains run ledgers, Agent Room records, approval items, Persona/Copy-Me state, redacted knowledge adapters, native HarvisBar/HarvisDesk surfaces, Presence, resident services, MCP/HTTP access, planning, review, and safe execution.
